findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec in urllib3
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts

module CodeInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(CodeExecution ce).getCode()
  }
}

module CodeInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CodeInjectionConfig>;
import CodeInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CodeInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CodeInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CodeInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Code injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Check for code injection vulnerabilities via eval/exec with untrusted input

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in urllib3
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe deserialization operations (pickle, yaml, marshal, shelve) that could lead to arbitrary code execution

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure TLS/SSL configuration
 * @description Weak SSL/TLS configurations can lead to man-in-the-middle attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-ssl
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Disabling SSL verification
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("_create_unverified_context").getACall()
  or
  // Setting verify=False in requests
  exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode sslCall |
    sslCall = API::moduleImport("urllib3").getMember(["PoolManager", "HTTPConnectionPool", "HTTPSConnectionPool"]).getACall() and
    exists(int i |
      call.getArg(i).asExpr().toString() = "verify=False"
    )
  )
  or
  // Using weak SSL/TLS versions
  exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode sslCall |
    sslCall = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("SSLContext").getMember(["set_ciphers", "options"]).getACall() and
    exists(int i |
      call.getArg(i).asExpr().toString().regexpMatch(".*(SSLv2|SSLv3|TLSv1|TLSv1\\.0|TLSv1\\.1).*")
    )
  )
select call, "Potentially insecure SSL/TLS configuration that could allow man-in-the-middle attacks."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure TLS/SSL configuration that could lead to man-in-the-middle attacks

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure random number generation
 * @description Using weak random number generators for security purposes can lead to predictable values
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-random
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-338
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Using random module for security purposes
  call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["random", "randint", "choice", "shuffle"]).getACall()
  or
  // Using time-based seeds for random
  exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode seedCall |
    seedCall = API::moduleImport("random").getMember("seed").getACall() and
    exists(int i |
      seedCall.getArg(i).asExpr().toString().regexpMatch(".*time.*")
    )
  )
select call, "Potentially insecure random number generation that may not be cryptographically secure."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure random number generation using weak random functions

message.text: Potentially insecure random number generation that may not be cryptographically secure.
